newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed down by 0.13 percent in lower trade after Thursday's holiday for the new Moslem year and ahead of the week end, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 497.41 from 498.07 last Wednesday.
Total volume was 1.55 million dinars against 4.26 million dinars.

BIAT bank was down 1.1 dinar to 35.9 dinars. Banque de l'Habitat fell 0.38 dinar to 18.62 dinars. Chemical firm al-Kimia slid 0.26 dinar to 46.02 dinars. Airline Tunis Air eased 0.14 dinar to 23.82 dinars.
Beer and Coca bottler SFBT was up 0.88 dinar to 91.88 dinars. Real estate Simpar rose 0.72 dinar to 25.36 dinars. Arab Tunisian Bank won 0.68 dinar to 31.8 dinars.
